messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick notice  we've updated the handbook section on parental/caregiver leave to clarify intermittent leave rules and how it coordinates with short-term disability. Please review and ack if you approve manager-level signoffs. Link: https://docs.redwoodinc.com/people/handbook/caregiver-leave

Maya (People Ops): We also published a 10-minute microlearning course for managers and manager-facing ICs. Completion required by Apr 18. Tracker + LMS link below.

Ravi (Engineering): For new managers, can this be part of the 30-day onboarding checklist?

Jules (HR Support): Yes  add to 30-day onboarding for new managers. For existing managers, complete by Apr 18. We'll add an "onboard_due" column in the tracker.

Ravi (Engineering): Contractors  should long-term vendor leads be included?

Jules (HR Support): Mandatory for W-2 staff and contractors with hiring/people decision authority. Vendor exceptions escalate to people-ops. We'll add a contractor flag in the tracker.

Lina (Legal): Quick legal notes: minor wording tweak suggested in "eligible caregiver" examples and clarify retroactive timeframe. Also, EU acknowledgements must be retained for 3 years.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks Lina  added EU column and updated wording. We'll snapshot the handbook after legal sign-off and send a short policy note tomorrow.

Onboarding-bot: Reminder: automated manager reminders for outstanding acks will run on Apr 6.

Ravi (Engineering): Can manager ack be an emoji on the tracker? I only have a couple minutes per team. :thumbsup:

Maya (People Ops): Emoji ok for quick ack. For audit we will populate a timestamped confirmation during LMS reconciliation.

Jules (HR Support): Action items: managers add teams to tracker, mark contractor flag if applicable, RSVP for Q&A slots on tracker, complete microlearning by Apr 18. People Ops will export completions Apr 19 and reconcile.

Maya (People Ops): Also: do not share medical/sensitive health info in Slack. Use the secure intake form linked on the handbook page. Thanks! :heart:
